# UnyKorn LLC — llms.txt
> Operator: UnyKorn LLC (Wyoming). Software and ops rails only. Not brokerage. Not an offer of securities.

This file is the free map. Full datasets, MCP tools, mint intake, and operator packs are paid.

## Genesis402 — pay for proof, not promises
Genesis402 is an in-progress proof and payment infrastructure stack with operational local receipt
issuance and x402 settlement capability. Public verification, discovery, anchoring, and broader
action-gating are being progressively released.

Maturity: x402 payment rail LIVE · payment receipts LIVE_LIMITED · proof receipt format FROZEN
(genesis402-receipt-v1) · proof receipt verifier LOCAL_ONLY · external anchoring NOT_YET_AVAILABLE ·
agent action authorization PAYMENTS_ONLY · RWA workflows NOT_OFFERED.

- Machine discovery (x402 v2): https://genesis402.com/.well-known/x402
- Live discovery, generated by the running rail (wins on conflict): https://twin.unykorn.org/.well-known/x402
- Agent card: https://genesis402.com/.well-known/agent.json
- OpenAPI (live routes only): https://genesis402.com/openapi.json
- Status snapshot: https://genesis402.com/status.json
- Pricing mirror: https://genesis402.com/pricing.json
- Security contact: https://genesis402.com/.well-known/security.txt

Authorized does not mean universally right. Refused does not mean universally wrong. Each receipt
reports an outcome under a declared scope, evidence state, policy version, and time.
